# Code of Conduct

## Our commitment

We want participation in ELTE Schedule Builder to be welcoming, useful, and
safe for students and contributors regardless of experience, identity,
background, or ability.

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful, patient, and specific.
- Critique ideas and changes rather than people.
- Assume good intent while accepting correction.
- Protect student privacy and remove personal schedule data from reports.
- Respect maintainers' time, project scope, and documented decisions.
- Help make technical discussions understandable to student contributors.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Harassment, threats, discrimination, or personal attacks.
- Sexualized language or unwanted attention.
- Trolling, sustained disruption, or deliberately misleading reports.
- Publishing another person's private information without permission.
- Pressuring anyone to disclose security details publicly.
- Abuse of project communication channels or infrastructure.

## Scope

This policy applies in repository issues, pull requests, reviews, and other
spaces used to represent or coordinate this project.

## Reporting and enforcement

Report conduct concerns privately to `w04m1@proton.me` with the subject
`ELTE Schedule Builder conduct report`. Include relevant links or screenshots
and avoid sharing unrelated personal information.

The maintainer may edit or remove contributions, limit participation, or take
other proportionate action. Reports will be reviewed as privately and fairly as
practical, but no formal response-time guarantee is provided.
